order: Execution Order: Revision of the Entry-State Indicator and Related Fixes (6 October 2026), section 7
status: REGISTERED - NOT RUN (waiting for the survivorship-free data: Sharadar/Norgate access pending receipt)

universe.source: point-in-time S&P 500 constituents from the purchased survivorship-free data (Sharadar or Norgate), delisted names included

outcomes.excess: stock total return minus SPY total return over the same sessions, net of costs
outcomes.drawdown_20: max(0, -(lowest close in sessions 1..20 / entry - 1)); the median is reported

contestants.a: events at which the revised machine reads READY or READY-HALF at the event close (trend gate not failed, setup, no ceiling cap from yearly highs known at the time, modifiers at or above a quarter); heavily_shorted not applied (no historical days-to-cover); the earnings modifier applied only if the data carries report dates
contestants.b: the first session within 10 sessions after the event at which the version-1 machine reads READY (trend, setup, trigger); outcomes from that session's close

bootstrap.blocks: event months resampled with replacement; each drawn month brings all its events from every contestant

power_check.pair: (c) split at random into two halves by event, seed 20261006, same statistics and bootstrap
power_check.passes: every difference's 90 percent interval (five statistics, two horizons) includes zero
power_check.if_fails: the real comparison is descriptive only; a new registration is required

decision_rule.supported: power check passes AND the 90% interval of (a)-(c) in mean 60-session excess lies entirely above zero AND the lower bound of (a)-(c) in the worst 10% at 60 sessions is no worse than -0.010
decision_rule.label: DIAGNOSTIC until this test reports; on 'supported' the operator decides whether to lift it; (b) vs (c) decides nothing

expected_result: not supported: (a)-(c) mean 60-session excess within plus or minus 1 point with an interval including zero; worst 10% similar; (b)-(c) similar with fewer events; median 20-session drawdowns within 1 point
seen_before_registration: the order's section 1 table (about 80 large companies, 2011-2026, 4,540 oversold events)
do_not_touch: nothing above changes once a run begins; a change requires a new registration with a stated reason, and both results are reported
